verbal_gradient.aim: Reduce max route distance gap to below 1.1 by tightening diversification and improving convergence.
avoid: Frequent random swaps or cross-exchange without acceptance check
Very early restart (below 100 non-improvement iterations) that discards progress
Excessive perturbation size (k>2) that may degrade routes
change: Lower initial temperature (e.g., 0.05 current_max) and faster decay (0.99)
Reduce random insertion probability and shake frequency; increase stagnation threshold for perturbation
preserve: multi-neighborhood local search (2-opt, relocate, swap, cross)
periodic worst-customer relocation from longest route
verbal_gradient.summary: Increased diversification yielded worse gap (1.916 vs parent 1.076), indicating too much exploration hurt solution quality.

name: m6_diversify_search
thought: Exploration-focused variant of Hybrid SALoadBalance. Increases diversification via randomized construction (10% chance of random insertion), higher initial temperature (0.2 * initial max), slower decay (0.995), more frequent perturbations (every 15 stagnation iterations, remove 4 customers from longest route), additional random swaps between routes, and earlier restart (80 non-improvement iterations). These changes promote broader exploration of the solution space while retaining the load-balancing construction and simulated annealing acceptance.
